00097 template <class XFadeTextureEventType, class OwnerType>
00098 class XFadeTextureEventUGenInternal : public XFadeTextureUGenInternal
00099 {
00100 public:
00101   XFadeTextureEventUGenInternal(const float sustainTime,
00102                   const float transitionTime,
00103                   const int numChannels, 
00104                   const int maxRepeats,
00105                   OwnerType* o) throw()
00106   : XFadeTextureUGenInternal(sustainTime, transitionTime, numChannels, maxRepeats), 
00107     event_(o)
00108   { 
00109   }
00110   
00111   XFadeTextureEventUGenInternal(const float sustainTime,
00112                   const float transitionTime,
00113                   const int numChannels, 
00114                   const int maxRepeats,
00115                   XFadeTextureEventType const& e) throw()
00116   : XFadeTextureUGenInternal(sustainTime, transitionTime, numChannels, maxRepeats), 
00117     event_(e)
00118   { 
00119   }
00120 
00121   UGen spawnEvent(SpawnUGenInternal& spawn, const int eventCount) throw()
00122   {
00123     UGen event = event_.spawnEvent(*this, eventCount);
00124     spawn.nextTime = transitionTime + sustainTime;
00125     Env env(Buffer(0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0), 
00126         Buffer(transitionTime, sustainTime, transitionTime), 
00127         EnvCurve::Welch);
00128     return event * EnvGen::KR(env, UGen::DeleteWhenDone);
00129   }
00130 
00131 protected:
00132   XFadeTextureEventType event_;
00133 };
00134

00239 class OverlapTextureUGenInternal : public SpawnUGenInternal
00240 {
00241 public:
00242   OverlapTextureUGenInternal(const float sustainTime_,
00243                  const float transitionTime_,
00244                  const int density_,
00245                  const int numChannels, 
00246                  const int maxRepeats)  throw()
00247   : SpawnUGenInternal(numChannels, (2.f * transitionTime_ + sustainTime_) / density_, maxRepeats),
00248     sustainTime(sustainTime_),
00249     transitionTime(transitionTime_),
00250     density(density_)
00251   {
00252     ugen_assert(sustainTime >= 0.f);
00253     ugen_assert(transitionTime >= 0.f);
00254     ugen_assert((sustainTime+transitionTime) > 0.f);
00255     ugen_assert(density > 0);
00256   }
00257   
00258   float sustainTime;
00259   float transitionTime;
00260   int density;
00261   
00262 protected:
00263 };

00478 template <class TrigXFadeEventType, class OwnerType>
00479 class TrigXFadeEventUGenInternal : public TrigXFadeUGenInternal
00480 {
00481 public:
00482   TrigXFadeEventUGenInternal(const int numChannels,
00483                     UGen const& trig,
00484                     const float transitionTime,
00485                     const int maxRepeats,
00486                     OwnerType* o) throw()
00487   : TrigXFadeUGenInternal(numChannels, trig, transitionTime, maxRepeats), 
00488     event_(o)
00489   { 
00490   }
00491   
00492   TrigXFadeEventUGenInternal(const int numChannels,
00493                     UGen const& trig,
00494                     const float transitionTime,
00495                     const int maxRepeats,
00496                     TrigXFadeEventType const& e) throw()

00502   UGen spawnEvent(TSpawnUGenInternal& spawn, const int eventCount, void* extraArgs = 0)
00503   {
00504     events.release();
00505     UGen event = event_.spawnEvent(*this, eventCount, extraArgs);
00506     Env env(Buffer(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), 
00507         Buffer(transitionTime, transitionTime), 
00508         EnvCurve::Welch, 1);
00509     return event * EnvGen::KR(env, UGen::DeleteWhenDone);
00510   }

00512 protected:
